profile_text.body:
Baidu is a Chinese technology company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Beijing. It is publicly traded under the ticker BIDU and operates as a for-profit public company. Its AI-facing web presence centers on the ERNIE platform at ernie.baidu.com, which serves as the home for its large model research and releases.

Baidu's primary AI product is ERNIE, a family of foundation models categorized as Chinese foundation models, with cross-border data review advised for users outside China. The company's site describes ERNIE 5.0 as a 2.4 trillion-parameter unified multimodal model trained from scratch, integrating text, image, video, and audio into a single autoregressive framework. A companion model, ERNIE-Image, is described as a text-to-image generation model built on a single-stream Diffusion Transformer architecture with 8 billion DiT parameters. The site also announces PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, an upgraded document understanding model the company describes as achieving a state-of-the-art accuracy of 94.5% on OmniDocBench v1.5.

Baidu holds an SEC filing under CIK 0001329099, consistent with its status as a publicly listed company. No litigation or MCP server records are present in the held facts.
